item.title: RadioWorkbench 0.16.0 · Español / English
item.description: Español: interfaz español/inglés, seis apartados de Ajustes, biblioteca configurable y respaldo ZIP manual, waterfall/menor consumo, datos y conexiones. English: Spanish/English interface, six Settings sections, configurable library/manual ZIP backup, waterfall/lower-power controls, data and connections. Experimental arm64 app, ad hoc signed, not notarized. Gracias / Thanks G4ZJH.
